rules.backReference: One required image while Back is selected; retain its stored value when hidden.
rules.emptyReferences: Use actual count; do not populate example images or the static 2/9 label.
rules.generation: Validate required fields then show service-not-connected notice. No generated result, task or charge.
rules.canvas: Reuse canvas assets by image URL, create missing assets at editor left, and bind via sourceImageId in one undo operation. Removing a reference preserves its canvas asset; deleting a canvas asset clears every bound reference.
rules.quickGeneration: Reference images are optional (0–9). A non-whitespace prompt is required; disable the quick-generation button while it is empty. Text-only input proceeds to the existing service-not-connected handler without opening the image picker.

reuse: 5.1 Beta theme tokens and original SVGs
designNotes: Latest storyboard context is 320x533 without smart expansion or generation settings.
Multi-view, storyboard and grid crop retain the supplied banner placeholder text until product copy is supplied.
New images use the existing video workspace image-sizing and placement rules. Sorting only changes reference order, not canvas identity or position.
